decision_table.name: Determine_CA_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file California state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

rule.policy:
CA filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in CA).
Reference: CA Revenue and Taxation Code § 23101 Reference: FTB Publication 1060 - Guide for Corporations Starting Business in California

CA filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $610,395 in CA sales (2025, indexed annually to CA per capita personal income).
Also nexus if substantial activity under CA Constitution (Quill overruled by Wayfair).
Reference: CA Revenue and Taxation Code § 23101 Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: FTB Notice 2019-01 - Economic Nexus
No CA nexus - no filing requirement.

decision_table.name: Calculate_CA_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate CA state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

rule.policy:
CA state-specific income adjustments.
Common CA additions: - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction (CA does not conform) - Interest on federal obligations (taxable to CA) - Bonus depreciation differences (CA partial conformity) - Related party expenses (IRC 163j differences)
Common CA subtractions: - Interest on CA municipal bonds - CA net operating loss deduction (different from federal) - Dividends received deduction differences
Reference: CA Form 100 Schedule J (Apportionment and Allocation) Reference: FTB Publication 1001 - Supplemental Guidelines to California Adjustments

decision_table.name: Calculate_CA_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate CA state corporate income tax. Applies 8.84% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Enforces $800 minimum franchise tax.

rule.policy:
CA corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income (Form 1120 line 28) 2. CA apportionment percentage (100% sales factor) 3. Apportioned income to CA 4. CA additions 5. CA subtractions 6. CA taxable income 7. CA tax rate: 8.84% (flat rate) 8. Tentative CA tax 9. Minimum franchise tax: $800 10. CA tax = greater of tentative tax or minimum 11. CA credits 12. Final CA tax (not less than minimum)
Minimum franchise tax: - $800 for most corporations - First year exemption for new corporations - S corporations also pay $800 minimum
Reference: CA Form 100 (Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return) Reference: CA Revenue and Taxation Code § 23151 (Tax rate: 8.84%) Reference: CA Revenue and Taxation Code § 23153 (Minimum franchise tax: $800) Reference: CA Form 100S (S Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return)

No CA taxable income, but $800 minimum franchise tax still applies.
Reference: CA Revenue and Taxation Code § 23153
No CA nexus - no tax or minimum franchise tax.

decision_table.name: Apply_CA_Waters_Edge_Election
decision_table.description: Apply CA water's edge election for worldwide combined reporting. Most taxpayers elect water's edge to limit worldwide income inclusion.

condition.name: has_waters_edge
condition.comment: Has elected water s edge treatment

rule.policy:
CA water's edge election limits worldwide combined reporting.
Includes only: - US corporations in unitary group - Certain specified foreign entities if elected
Election is binding for 84 months (7 years).
Reference: CA Revenue and Taxation Code § 25110 Reference: FTB Publication 1061 - Guidelines for Corporations Filing a Combined Report

actions.action: // Worldwide combined reporting // Includes all unitary group members worldwide

rule.policy:
Worldwide combined reporting includes all unitary group members globally.
Reference: CA Revenue and Taxation Code § 25101
Standalone corporation - no combined reporting required.
